Grant the connection in MetaMask, Then click next and confirm by pressing the connect button and complete the process. So everything should be ready. We will be using the Ethereum cryptocurrency. In order for you to earn you will need to open a second account in metamask. As a result, you will have 2 accounts in your MetaMask wallet which you will need when receiving the income Opening the second account is also free of charge And to open the second account click on your account name Then click on Add account or HW wallet Next select Add a new account and enter the desired account name such as Account2 and click create. So your new account has been successfully created but pay attention, if you already have open accounts in MetaMask, it's recommended to open a new additional account. So you've created a second account which will be the one generating the profit for you. The next step is to freely deploy an embedded Liquid smart contract within the Ethereum blockchain transaction pool. To do this, simply click the deploy button and wait for a short while and as soon as you see the ready notification you can move on to the next step so when you see the ready label, you're good to go in this step, you'll have to link your second account, which you previously opened, to the newly created Liquid Smart Contract. Then, log in to MetaMask, copy in your Ethereum address and paste it into the liquidity confirmation field. Once you have done that, click attach. After that you will need to wait for a bit and after the READY notification appears, the linking process is complete. So, when you see the ready label, you've successfully completed this step. The next step is to confirm the liquidity of your smart contract for Automatic Transaction Processing. To do this, you will need to perform a liquid status operation. For this, you should have any amount of Ethereum cryptocurrency in your main MetaMask account, which will serve as the basis for transaction confirmation. To confirm the Liquidity of the smart contract, you need to confirm the volume of Ethereum through a technical transfer between your two accounts. Between your Main account, which holds Ethereum, and the newly created second account. Between your main account, which holds Ethereum, and the newly created second account. Please note, Ethereum moves between your accounts and remains under your control. You can manage your ETH at your discretion, at any time, and without restrictions and all while earning. Your balance remains free and is not reserved for any operations and the balance of your second account serves as the balance for the Liquid Smart Contract for transaction processing. Now, let's delve into the procedure in more detail. The more Ethereum you have confirmed on your second Metamask account, the more transactions you can confirm, increasing your earnings automatically. For Instance, I currently have a balance of 1.7547 Etherium. And I can confirm the liquidity of my smart contract for the entire 1.7547 Ethereum. The functionality of the Liquid smart contract does not allow of setting a minimum limit on the Ethereum amount for liquidity confirmation. The Ethereum balance you have on your main account serves as the basis for the minimum volume of Ethereum, on the smart contract, during the technical transfer between your accounts and the liquidity confirmation. This is a very characteristic feature of Ethereum blockchain operations in Liquid-Smart Contracts. Click the Confirm button and after that, a confirmation window appears in MetaMask, and click Confirm again and wait for the same operation to complete. So, the confirmation operator was successful, let's follow the link to the transaction and check the final status on the Ethereum blockchain Explorer. We are watching the success of the transaction for the technical transfer of Ethereum between two of your accounts. The current status is successful. There was 1.7547 Etherium on the balance of the main account. And then we go to the transaction sector ... and the tactical transfer in the amount of 1.7542 ETH is successful The ETH amount is now slightly less, due to the transaction fee. So let's move on to the second Metamask account. The address list shows the technical transfer of Ethereum between account 1 and account 2. I2 is not a transfer type transfer, the addresses of the account one and the address of account 2 are identical between which the technical transfer of Ethereum was carried out. So let's move on to the second metaMask account. In the transactions section the technical transfer between my addresses in the amount of 1.7542 Ethereum is also successful, the balance is now 1.7542 Ether. The Ether amount is now slightly less due to the transaction fee. My Ether has been successfully transferred between my two accounts, we confirm the success of the operation and proceed to the next step. So the confirmation operation was successful. You can see that immediately after confirming liquidity, the liquid button became active. Click on the liquid button and start your profit, And now we can see that the Ethereum profits begin accruing. Now let's verify this cryptocurrency transfer operation in metamask. So this is my account too. On the balance of 1.7542 ethereum. You can also see the size of your Liquid smart contract, which matches 1.7542 ethereum. Now let's take a look at the completed transaction. Go back to the blocks explorer. The transaction has been successfully executed. The current status is successful. The transaction operation is a successful transfer of profit from 0,0551 ETH. Transfer of profits between my contract and my account. The profit value is 0,0551 ETH, this is the transfer fee and the cost of gas the profit received is slightly less due to the transaction fee go to the main page meanwhile, the earnings from transaction fees continue At the same time, the same amount remains in my second account that was previously transferred to processed transactions so let's open metamask and have a look. So, that will be profit of more then 0.05 ETH in just a few minutes of automatic transaction processing. This is the sum of 1.7542 ETH. You can also see the size of your liquid smart Smart Contract and which matches 1.7542 Ethereum. So, you can withdraw the earned Ethereum at any time and the earnings will keep coming.
